professional_nodes.matter: historic Aweswell/LPB project-side counsel; DP 1041/2017; specific LPB mandate terminated by the Insolvency Administrator on 25-Jan-2018 after documented Bar/judicial threats; 21-Aug-2026 Tenerife communication seeks preservation and certification of any Bar action directed at him
professional_nodes.boundary: Por Derecho/Aweswell makes no allegation of professional misconduct against Cristo. The documented Bar threat and specific mandate termination do not prove that ICATF opened or decided a file, that the IA's conduct was legally unlawful, or that the pressure alone caused the later DP 1041/2017 discontinuance.
proved: Cristo acted for LPB in DP 1041/2017; the 19-Dec-2017 court order admitted the requested preliminary diligence seeking CAM's complete credit-assignment deed, including price, payment date and transaction costs.
On 18-Jan-2018 the Insolvency Administrator warned several lawyers including Cristo that unauthorised acts would be reported to Fiscalía and the Bar.

On 25-Jan-2018 the Insolvency Administrator told Cristo he would report the matter to the Bar for the corresponding purposes, terminated the specific LPB professional relationship, requested venia, required him not to act, warned of judicial action and instructed the procurador not to file without IA authorisation.
No voluntary resignation by Cristo from that specific LPB mandate has been located.
Cristo continued broader Sun Park legal work after January 2018.
On 4-Feb-2023 Cristo recovered the 25-Jan-2018 email and described it as the email relating to the complaint to the Bar and the other threats.
The 21-Aug-2026 ICATF communication expressly states that it is not a complaint against Cristo and seeks preservation/certification of whether the documented threat became a Bar action.
